name: SuelosAR agronomic reference basemap — Córdoba
projection: WGS84 lon/lat rendered by flutter_map with the same Web Mercator camera as soil PMTiles
source: Instituto Geografico Nacional de la Republica Argentina WFS (wms.ign.gob.ar/geoserver/wfs), clipped to the real Córdoba province polygon (layer ign:provincia)
localitySource: GeoRef Argentina API v2.0 /localidades?provincia=14; official locality IDs, categories, centroids and department IDs; retrieved 2026-10-31. Existing curated point names, coordinates and importance are retained; source identity is joined by exact normalized name and nearest official locality group. Added points use simple or compound locality visibility at z9.5-10.3 and entity visibility at z11.5-12.3.
